name: Pearl Harbor Lighthouse — surface and detail kit
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Visible source facts: Tapered pearl lighthouse with small gold lantern crown, ring balconies, narrow arched windows, a conspicuous lilac spiral band and irregular rock island foot. The drawing does not establish whether the spiral is a usable stair or only cladding. Hidden layout inference: Provide one sheltered boat/shore landing and a short rock path to the entry, with a loop around the base and a defined climb to a lookout if intended playable. Preserve the spiral as visual identity; do not silently claim its band supplies the entire ascent. Preserve this local design. Exactly12 isolated main components in a clean4-column grid. No missing/empty slots or repeated subjects counted twice. One clear front/three-quarter view with useful small rear/top/contact inset per cell. Truly flat backs for appliques, square join ends for repeat mouldings. Screens have repeated coherent holes, no tangled tendrils. Windows separate glass from surrounds, cornices/parapets and posts separate where named. Do not include large room/scenery fragments attached to a tiny detail. Title "B22-DETAIL-001 — Pearl Harbor Lighthouse — surface and detail kit". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".

Purpose/gap: Need tapered shaft/base/lantern seat, balcony window band and spiral cladding/ramp decision; source pearl/lilac/gold style retained. Shared shore rocks/dock/stairs/lights reused. Sparse coastal grasses and seabirds; beam effects, internal stairs and tide access remain proposed. Missing detached construction pieces and local interior-facing patterns.
